brief_rationale: Grade 4 Strong: All seven responsibility chain items are met without serious error. Three high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3) are completed with meaningful trajectory impact: the doctor verified ambiguous data through multiple channels including workspace queries and patient/family read-back with external window confirmation, corrected patient misconceptions about 'kidney failure' from renal calcifications, and built a practical workaround for photo/document barriers with organized checklists and fallback sources. One high-order point (HO4) was triggered but partial—the doctor discovered and integrated some historical context but did not fully articulate the multi-year renal/urologic timeline from available EHR. No important non-chain defect is present.
